justification: Both surfaces carry figures modelled in shallow relief and read as silhouettes arranged along a horizontal band, and both use a similarly schematic, outline-driven manner with angular limb details. But the subjects differ fundamentally: A shows a crowded row of interlinked human figures with raised arms in an animated group scene, while B shows a single quadruped animal in profile above a plain curved line, with no figural interaction at all.
